name: Franzlhof
beschreibung:
Boasting a magnificent panoramic vantage point facing the Wilder Kaiser, Franzlhof in Soell features comfortable guestrooms, camping grounds, and varied recreational facilities. An on-site restaurant serves authentic Tyrolean delicacies.

Delightful hiking trails and easy access to the SkiWelt network start right on the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Franzlhof in Soell brings together hotel amenities, camping, and leisure activities by the Wilder Kaiser.
